source.manualTitle: LG Freestanding & Slide-In Ranges (LRE30451/LRE30755, LRGL5821S, LSG4513)

steps.title: Disconnect power (and gas if applicable)
steps.body: Unplug the range or disconnect power. Turn off gas supply on gas models. Resistance checks require power off and disconnected harnesses. Replace all panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with power cord unplugged from outlet.

steps.title: Door switch continuity
steps.body: Power off. Door open = infinite Ω; door closed = continuity (0 Ω) at door switch.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Door open = infinite Ω; door closed = continuity (0 Ω) at door switch.

steps.title: Replace door switch
steps.oemOutcome: Door switch fails continuity check — replace switch.
